title: Alexander Wiggins Omaha tic-tac and USS Jackson
summary: Tim Gallaudet tells of Alexander Wiggins Omaha tic-tac and USS Jackson, about 2019 at Off Southern California, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: I think he was on the bridge of the Omaha when that that one object spherical object goes into the water.
